info.name: Lab 2 — Guided Gateway and concurrency demo
info.description: A numbered real-user demonstration through the public Gateway, followed by a controlled 100-slot overload and recovery. Run requests manually in order, using the separate environment template. These are successful, currently demonstrated lobby and permission flows; this collection does not assert Session activation or WebSocket frame delivery.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get("gateway_url")) throw new Error("Set the public Gateway URL in the private runtime environment");
const scope = pm.environment.get("session_id") || pm.environment.get("run_id") || "manual";
const name = "key_" + pm.info.requestName + "_" + scope;
let key = pm.environment.get(name);
if (!key) { key = pm.variables.replaceIn("{{$randomUUID}}"); pm.environment.set(name, key); }
pm.variables.set("request_key", key);

request.description: Send to the public Gateway. Run the preceding numbered requests first. The test checks the actual response and retains only resource IDs in the Postman environment.

exec: const run = pm.variables.replaceIn("{{$randomUUID}}").replace(/-/g, "");
pm.environment.set("run_id", run);
for (const key of ["session_id", "team_id", "player0", "player1", "player2", "token0", "token1", "token2"]) pm.environment.unset(key);
for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
pm.environment.set("username" + i, "lab2_" + run.slice(0, 16) + "_" + i);
pm.environment.set("email" + i, "lab2_" + run + "_" + i + "@example.test");
pm.environment.set("password" + i, pm.variables.replaceIn("{{$randomUUID}}") + "Aa1!");
pm.test("HTTP status is expected", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(200));
let data;
try { data = pm.response.json(); } catch (_) { data = null; }
pm.test("Response is a JSON object", () => pm.expect(!!data && typeof data === "object" && !Array.isArray(data)).to.equal(true));
if (!data || pm.response.code !== 200) { throw new Error("Unexpected response; sensitive body withheld"); }
pm.test("Process reports ok", () => pm.expect(data.status === "ok").to.equal(true));

request.description: Have request 28 selected and ready. In a terminal run: python3 postman/lab2-overload.py. When READY appears, click Send immediately (within about 6 seconds). The helper fills the 100 live task slots with incomplete requests that cannot create a Player; this extra protected read receives the Gateway capacity error. If you miss the window, rerun the helper rather than weakening the assertion.

exec: let body;
try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (_) { body = null; }
pm.test("101st concurrent task is rejected, not queued", () => {
pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(503);
pm.expect(body && body.code).to.eql("TASK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED");
pm.test("Structured, retryable Gateway response", () => {
pm.expect(body && Array.isArray(body.details)).to.eql(true);
pm.expect(body && body.request_id).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/);
pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Request-ID")).to.eql(body.request_id);
pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Retry-After")).to.eql("1");
